title: Libby case profile (scrubbed, committable)
description: Derived non-identifying snapshot of a single patient case. Generated by the intake agent and validated by promote_profile.py before entering data/.

case_slug.description: Kebab-case clinical-descriptor slug; must not be patient-initials or birthdate-shaped.

primary_site.description: Anatomic site (e.g. 'lung', 'colorectal', 'breast'). Not a diagnosis date.

confirmation_status.description: How firm is this biomarker call? `confirmed` means the result is at the resolution required for clinical decisions (e.g. IHC for a BiTE/ADC target, NGS for a mutation). Non-confirmed values trigger PI scenario branching: the PI emits separate ranked recommendations for the positive and negative cases.

decision_resolution.description: What level of confirmation IS required for clinical decisions on this biomarker? E.g. 'IHC SP347 ≥1%' for DLL3-directed therapy, 'tissue NGS' for a driver mutation. Used by the PI to phrase the workup recommendation.

current_therapy.description: Free text — what the patient is on at intake, or null.

organ_function.description: Lab values as numerics or qualitative tiers (e.g. 'CrCl_ml_min': 78, 'AST_U_L': 32).

geography_band.description: Country or US census region — never ZIP / city / hospital name.

private.description: If true, do not generate public docs/cases/<slug>/ pages — keep local-only.
